summary: Markdown [text](url) spans become Draft.js LINK entities, HTML comment lines never ship as article text, and an in-place update lane (articles update-md) reuses the create path's GraphQL composition instead of re-creating drafts.
reason: A live publishing session proved three runtime realities a regen must preserve: (1) X hyperlinks exist only as LINK entities - Mutable, data {entityKey: <uuid>, url: <verbatim url, not t.co-wrapped>}, UTF-16 entity_ranges (shape harvested from composer-authored article 2064864205749280768) - so links must be entities, not text; (2) body edits must go through ArticleEntityUpdateContent with the create path's exact variable shape {content_state: {blocks, entity_map}, article_entity} on the existing id - guessed shapes 422 and re-creating drafts mints duplicates; (3) UpdateContent replaces the whole body, so an update lane must preflight the draft's content_state and refuse on entity types the converter cannot reproduce. queryIds resolve through the article-ops table (X rotates them); a regen must re-discover current hashes, not enshrine these.
validated_outcome: Construction-level so far: all 35 LINK entities harvested from live article 2064864205749280768 round-trip through the converter in dry-run with shape parity, and update-md's composition/preflight/republish sequencing is covered by fake-transport unit tests. PENDING live smoke at shipping time, to be recorded here: (1) update-md round-trip on a scratch draft - create via articles-publish-md --draft, mutate the markdown (text + new link + new image), run update-md, confirm via articles list that the id is unchanged and body/links/image updated; (2) the embed decision gate - send one bare tweet-URL line through articles-publish-md --draft on a scratch draft and confirm X renders the markdown-authored TWEET entity, which narrows the browser-only embed lane to composer-only artifacts in pre-existing drafts.
